metadata.description: Delegates one customer subscription to Synextra through Azure Lighthouse, read-only. Deploy in the CUSTOMER tenant against the subscription being delegated: az deployment sub create --location uksouth --template-file delegate-subscription.json --parameters @delegate-subscription.parameters.json. Keep mspOfferName identical across redeployments: the registration definition id is derived from it, so the same name updates the existing delegation in place instead of creating a second one.
Shown to the customer under Service providers. Must stay stable: it is the identity of the delegation.

mspOfferDescription.defaultValue: Read-only monitoring by Synextra. No write access is granted.
